question: A sheet of paper is divided into 8 equal parts, and 1 part is shaded. What fraction of the sheet is shaded? Use \(1\div8\) to represent each part. Calculate: \(1\div8=?\) (Answer as a decimal.)
solution: Each part is \(\frac{1}{8}\) of the sheet. To find its decimal value, think of one whole as \(1000\) thousandths. Since \(125\times8=1000\), sharing these thousandths equally among \(8\) parts gives \(125\) thousandths per part. The first three places after the decimal point represent tenths, hundredths, and thousandths. Thus \(125\) thousandths is \(1\) tenth, \(2\) hundredths, and \(5\) thousandths, written \(0.125\). Since \(1\div8=\frac{1}{8}=0.125\), the requested decimal answer is \(0.125\).
